name: DF_RELEASE_TYPE_SELECT
description: Select one of six release types

fields.label: Release Type *
options: applicant_cheque:RL-01 By Applicant – By Cheque (Pool Eligible, Letter on Initiator)
ac_holder_cheque:RL-02 By A/C Holder – By Cheque (Pool Eligible, Letter on Initiator)
court:RL-03 Court Release – By Branch/NPA (Pool Eligible, Letter on Initiator)
npa:RL-04 NPA Release – By NPA (Letter on CAD screen)
partial:RL-05 Partial Release – Guarantor only (Letter on CAD, borrower remains)
temporary:RL-06 Temporary Release – 6 months EMI plan (Letter on CAD)

fields.label: Reviewing Authority Routing *
options: pool:BROPs Pool – Branch Operations Control (claim before review) – only for cheque types
fields.hint: Select per reporting structure: BOC-reporting branch → BROPs Pool

javascript: var descs = {applicant_cheque: 'Release initiated by payee/applicant on basis of cheque. Letter auto-generated after review; initiator signs.', ac_holder_cheque: 'Release by account holder. Sufficient balance + lien applied automatically.', court: 'Court order release: branch → Legal consent → BOC approval → BROPs → CAD.', npa: 'Full release after loan regularization/settlement. LOS evidence, CAD generates letter.', partial: 'Guarantor only released, borrower remains blacklisted. Party-level outcome.', temporary: '6 months only based on EMI plan. Charges mandatory.'}; $('#releaseType').setOnchange(function(v){ $('#releaseTypeDescription').setValue(descs[v]||''); var chequeTypes=['applicant_cheque','ac_holder_cheque','court']; if(chequeTypes.indexOf(v)==-1){ $('#routeMode').setValue('bm'); } });
